text: brew formula name 'ledger' is shadowed by homebrew-core's ledger-cli (accounting, 3.4.x): bare 'brew upgrade ledger' replaces our tool with the accounting program (happened live on jesse's machine cutting v0.2.0; repaired via fully-qualified reinstall). Fix candidates: rename the formula, conflicts_with declaration, or document fully-qualified install/upgrade everywhere
